properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true TheomAlerts_CL, TheomAlertsV2_CL
| extend
    Properties = column_ifexists('Properties', dynamic(null)),
    CustomProps = column_ifexists('CustomProps', dynamic(null))
| extend
    AccountId = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('AccountId', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('accountId_s', ''))),
    CloudProvider = tostring(column_ifexists('CloudProvider', '')),
    DeepLink = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('DeepLink', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('deepLink_s', ''))),
    Details = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Details', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('details_s', ''))),
    Id = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Id', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('id_s', ''))),
    Priority = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Priority', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('priority_s', ''))),
    LastTriggered = coalesce(todatetime(column_ifexists('LastTriggered', datetime(null))), unixtime_seconds_todatetime(todouble(column_ifexists('customProps_LastTriggered_s', '')))),
    NumTriggered = tolong(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('NumTriggered', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('customProps_NumTriggered_s', '')))),
    Risk = tostring(column_ifexists('Risk', '')),
    RuleName = tostring(column_ifexists('RuleName', '')),
    Region = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Region', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('customProps_Region_s', '')), tostring(CustomProps.Region), tostring(Properties.Region)),
    RemediationSteps = column_ifexists('RemediationSteps', dynamic(null)),
    Scopes = column_ifexists('Scopes', dynamic(null)),
    Summary = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Summary', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('summary_s', ''))),
    Tags = coalesce(column_ifexists('Tags', dynamic(null)), parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists('tags_s', '')))),
    AlertType = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('AlertType', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('type_s', ''))),
    AssetName = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('customProps_AssetName_s', '')), tostring(CustomProps.AssetName), tostring(Properties.AssetName)),
    AssetType = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('customProps_AssetType_s', '')), tostring(CustomProps.AssetType), tostring(Properties.AssetType)),
    AssetNERValue = coalesce(todouble(column_ifexists('customProps_AssetNERValue_s', '')), todouble(column_ifexists('customProps_AssetNERValue_d', real(null))), todouble(CustomProps.AssetNERValue), todouble(Properties.AssetNERValue)),
    RuleId = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('customProps_RuleId_s', '')), tostring(CustomProps.RuleId), tostring(Properties.RuleId))
| project TimeGenerated, AccountId, CloudProvider, DeepLink, Details, Id, Priority, LastTriggered, NumTriggered, Risk, RuleName, Region, RemediationSteps, Scopes, Summary, Tags, AlertType, AssetName, AssetType, AssetNERValue, RuleId, Properties, CustomProps
